## Workflow

What were you trying to query, and what do you currently use for that task? A general description is enough; do not share confidential project details.

## Getting started

Which version and platform did you try? How long did setup take? Did you complete a useful query and verify its result?

## Data-model fit

What was straightforward or difficult to represent? Mention late observations, payload size or retained-history requirements if relevant.

## Next use

Would you use it again for your own work? What is the first change you would need? Keep commercial terms and private contact details out of this public issue.
